func run(items: [Int]) async throws {
  for batch in items.chunks(ofCount: 1) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { tasks in
      for item in batch { tasks.addTask { try await save(item) } }
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
      try await tasks.waitForAll()
    }
  }
  let saved = items.chunks(ofCount: 1)
  for batch in saved {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { tasks in
      for item in batch { tasks.addTask { try await save(item) } }
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
      try await tasks.waitForAll()
    }
  }
  for batch in items.chunks(ofCount: 4) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { tasks in
      for item in batch { tasks.addTask { try await save(item) } }
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
      try await tasks.waitForAll()
    }
  }
}
